evidence.AC1: POST /todos with {"title":"past","dueDate":"2026-10-22"} returned 201 with dueDate "2026-10-22". A POST without dueDate returned dueDate:null. The value is a plain YYYY-MM-DD string with no time.
evidence.AC2: PATCH /todos/4 with {"dueDate":"2020-05-05"} returned the todo with dueDate 2020-05-05. PATCH with {"dueDate":null} then returned dueDate:null and overdue:false, so the date is changed and removed.
